svg.aria-label: Measured: 131 of 160 real testbed attacks caught at 8 alerts a shift, against 52 for the best baseline checked; 146 of 150 lying sensors named on unseen simulated runs; 0 of 80 attacks closed; 6 of 29 alerts unexplained in two held-back years on a real wind farm
svg.title: Measured: 131 of 160 real testbed attacks caught at 8 alerts a shift, against 52 for the best baseline checked; 146 of 150 lying sensors named on unseen simulated runs; 0 of 80 attacks closed; 6 of 29 alerts unexplained in two held-back years on a real wind farm

text.tspan: Attacks caught. Three HAI editions. 8 alerts a shift.
Both bars share this scale of 160.
Lying sensor named, on simulated runs
it never saw. None named wrong.
Alerts no log explained. Two years held
back, on a real wind farm with no attacks.
Each mark above is scaled to its own count, not to 160.
Simulated plants are a diagnosis, not a real-plant result.
